Ready to pay? お会計をお願いします。
Okaikei o onegaishimasu.
The bill, please.
Payment routines vary between restaurants. Follow the staff's instructions and check whether you should pay at the counter. Keep one useful phrase ready instead of trying to memorise a whole conversation.

A beautiful place can still have photography restrictions. Look for signs, avoid blocking paths and ask when unsure.
写真を撮ってもいいですか。
Shashin o totte mo ii desu ka?
May I take a photograph?
Respect a refusal and keep other visitors out of close-up shots unless they agree.
